paragraphs: Chapter 783
Episode 193. The Shaman (1)
Bancellar, the Holy Kingdom.
It's been six days since Runcandel learned about the explosion in the Tower of Stories. Up until now, the Runcandel-Vamel alliance hasn't heard anything about Kadun.

"Hmm, Kadun. It seems that there's a problem with that arrogant Fire Dragon. He didn't attend the union meeting held the day before yesterday. Kadun was known to consistently attend these meetings and create a tense atmosphere," said Talaris.
She regained consciousness six days ago and had to stay in the Holy Kingdom for the time being, continuing to receive treatment from Lani. She also had to assist Lani.
"I also have the feeling that Zipfel is not trying to hide that there might be a problem with Kadun. Of course, he could be somewhere we don't know about, perfectly fine."
"So, is our son-in-law planning to go to the scene personally tomorrow?"
"Yes."
"If Mort's help is needed, our daughter will have to go as well, right?"
"That's correct."
"Well, it should be a good time, but hmm..."
Talaris trailed off.
As someone who's had countless romances, the greatest love guru of this era.

Talaris intuitively realized that there was some progress in the relationship between Jin and Valeria. Hence, the issue of Jin and Syris's marriage was the first thing Talaris addressed upon waking up.
'Valeria Hister. She is definitely a highly attractive girl, but I didn't expect Jin, who has never shown interest in the opposite sex, to fall for her like this.'
In terms of lacking interest in the opposite sex, Syris surpassed Jin.
From what Talaris saw, Syris had feelings for Jin. However, those feelings weren't limited to romantic emotions.
As a friend, as a warrior, as a person of the opposite sex. Syris had definite affection for Jin, but she didn't actively express it.

'She probably thinks that fulfilling her duties as the next owner of the Hidden Palace is the priority. Becoming the mistress of the Hidden Palace is wrong for Jin now. But, in this era, what does that matter? The Hidden Palace and Runcandel are already in an alliance anyway. Nevertheless, she's stubborn...'
"Lady Talaris."
"Huh, yes?"
"What are you thinking about?"
"I'm just a bit worried."
"Are you worried about me going to the Tower of Stories?"
At that, Talaris looked straight at Jin. Silence fell for a moment.
"You might want to maintain this distance."
"Pardon?"

"Sometimes, there are relationships where you don't want to get closer because you're afraid of losing them.... That can also be an endearing charm. There were a few such people in my long and illustrious history."
"I don't understand what you're suddenly saying..."
"My mind drifted back to the old days for a moment. Ha, I suddenly miss your father and Ron. I should visit Gumphwangji. I could also check the construction site of the union's dry dock."
"If Lady Talaris looks into it, it will be a great honor for those working there."
"By the way, it's a shame that your elder brother, the Black Dragon, will need more time to return. I couldn't refuse the help offered by the King of Saints."
What Lani asked Talaris to help with was assisting in sealing the 'Eye of Zito'.
"Maintaining the seal of Zito is also for the union. So, don't worry."
"Son-in-law, in my opinion, it is inevitable that the Demon King Zito will awaken someday. Perhaps, Elona Zipfel as well."
"Yes, everyone is prepared. No matter when they awaken, there won't be a crisis of world destruction like during the time of the malevolent gods."
"You're very reliable, our son-in-law. It feels like it was just the other day when I met that boy who risked his life in Colonn, but now he's grown into a giant."
"I have always relied on Hidden Palace's help since then. Without the connection with Hidden Palace, I would have died many times."
"Remember that. For me and for Syris."
"Of course, I will do my best. If there's anything lacking, please let me know at any time."
When Jin said this with a wide smile, Talaris laughed without realizing it. The fact that he had grown into a giant yet still retained his naive boyishness was endearing.
In Talaris's eyes, Jin was still a pure child. Despite obtaining such power and authority, Jin hadn't fallen into corruption, nor had he become lonely.
"I'm glad you didn't take after your father completely. If you're leaving tomorrow, you have a lot to prepare, so go now."
"Understood, Lady Talaris. Please take care."
"Don't get hurt, and don't hurt my daughter or Mort. If you do, I won't let it go."
"Of course."
Jin bowed his head and went outside. Talaris shrugged her shoulders and said,
"Well... Kids should handle their own matters. A love triangle, that's interesting. No, if you count Sandra Zipfel, is it a love quadrangle? Quite the devil, our son-in-law."
Early the next morning.
Those who infiltrated the Tower of Stories gathered in the Nameless Hall. They were Jin, Valeria, Syris, Yona, and Owl.
Including Jin in their party, they became a group that wouldn't feel threatened anywhere in the continent.
Despite their mission to find the heart of enemy territory, there was no serious aura among them.
"Hehe, little one!"
Rather, Yona was visibly excited at the prospect of going to 'Masil' with her little brother after a long time.
The party was filled with people Yona liked. Not to mention Jin and Owl, Yona also had a considerable fondness for Valeria and Syris.
From the start, Valeria was a nameless benefactor, and Syris was the master of Hidden Palace, who saved Jin several times.
So, Yona was in high spirits. She hopped around soundlessly, climbed on people's shoulders, almost like a bird.
"It's still hard to read your movements, sister."
"Oh! Does that mean you can read them now?"
"I've grown a lot."
"Then, there won't be any assassin who can kill the youngest alone. Maybe even if the whole of Nameless came at him, it would be alright?"
"Oh, Yona. Stay still for a moment, you're too spirited."
"Do you want to die?"
"Um, yes... I'll stay still."
"Hehe, I'm joking. Don't be scared. And don't worry, once we reach the operation area, I'll blend in like air. I think it would be nice to cut off a few Zipfel friends' necks on the way."
"Yona, you can't do that. We are going for investigation, not assassination today."
"Of course, I'm not a fool anymore so I know that much. Right, Valeria?"
"It seems so."
"So, you're saying I was a fool in the past? Do you want to die too?"
"Please spare me."
"Alright, I'll spare you."

Syris had a tendency not to resist anything cute, and for some reason, he couldn't take his eyes off Yona's foolish behavior for a while. There weren't many people in the world who found Yona cute, and Syris was one of them.
"Master! What are you staring at? He."
"I just looked."
Syris couldn't muster the courage to add that he thought she was cute.
"Just!?"
"Syris, let's get going."
"Alright."
Syris summoned Mort.
[Vooong.]

"Once Mort's dimensional travel is completed, we'll arrive at the Teia Plains, about 30 ri away from the Tower of Stories. After the King of Nameless completes the entire concealment operation upon arrival, we will approach the tower."
Jin said.
The ability to conceal others was far superior in Owl than in Yona. That's why, in the past, in the Sota Desert, Rosa was able to secretly watch Jin and his party and Zipfel.

"The best case scenario is to approach safely after arrival, examine the records and leave. Even if we're discovered, I think the possibility of a fight is low, but if something like that happens, we'll retreat immediately."
It would be insane to engage in a battle in enemy territory, especially at the Tower of Stories, even if Jin was present. It was best to retreat first and then consider the next step.

"Hehe, you don't have to worry about getting caught, youngest. Even if we are detected outside the 30 ri, even through dimensional infiltration, our Owl should retire. What kind of King of Nameless would he be?"
"Yona...."
"Do you want to die?"
"Hehe, I just called out. Let's go."
In no time, Owl had become even more foolish like Yona. Owl didn't try to hide that fact, and Jin thought it was quite pleasing to see.
The party climbed onto Mort.
A white dimensional gate opened and after running through the icy plains of another dimension for a while, they were able to reach the Teia Plains in no time.
"...Is this the Teia Plains?"
"Mort, did you get us to the right place?"
Jin and Syris asked at the same time. The Teia Plains they saw before them looked completely different from what they knew.
The land was so rough and broken that it belied the name "plains". And in various places, a dark soul energy burned like fire.
Mort had definitely come to the Teia Plains correctly.
Then, there could only be one explanation for this dark landscape.
"...The remnants of the battle have been left untouched. This soul energy, it's probably spread by Kelliark Zipfel."
The moment Kelliark's rampage was confirmed as true. Mort coughed in the soul energy and hid in the icy otherworld, and Jin protected the party with a barrier of spirit energy.
Despite bringing the King of Nameless, Owl, they weren't in a situation where they could effectively hide. The visibility was bad, and they couldn't even see the tower.
Just as they were about to consider their response, the party felt a dark energy approaching from ahead. It was a man stained dark by soul energy.
He had a face everyone in the party was familiar with.
Kelliark Zipfel, the head of the Zipfel.
He was approaching the party, making animal-like noises.
"Kelliark Zipfel...!?"
[Aaah!]
Kelliark even attacked the party outright. Jin stepped forward and cut him in half with a single stroke.
Kelliark disintegrated into particles and scattered somewhere. Something that could never happen if it was the real Kelliark Zipfel.
Looking around again, they saw many Kelliark Ziphres, looking exactly like the one who had just scattered, approaching the party.
"It seems something has gone terribly wrong."
Jin, no longer flustered, put strength into his hand gripping the sword.
